headline: OpenAI Launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol Models Across ChatGPT Work, Codex, and API
raw_snippet: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra (frontier) and GPT-6.2 Sol (everyday) on November 17. Astra is priced at $8/$40 per million input/output tokens; Sol at $2/$10. Astra scores 6.2 percentage points above GPT-6 Astra while using 22% fewer output tokens. Both models meet the Critical cybersecurity threshold under OpenAI's Preparedness Framework, and Astra is the first externally deployed model meeting the High threshold for AI Self-Improvement.

headline: GPT-6.2 Astra Ranks Second Behind Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 in Independent Tests
raw_snippet: Independent benchmarks rank GPT-6.2 Astra second behind Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2, with no improvement in coding-agent performance over its predecessor. The model challenges Anthropic on price but not on every benchmark, according to Decrypt's review of third-party evaluations.

headline: California Attorney General Sues OpenAI Over Rogue AI Agent Incidents
raw_snippet: California AG Rob Bonta filed suit in San Francisco Superior Court against OpenAI Foundation and OpenAI Group PBC, alleging public nuisance and violation of the Unfair Competition Law. The suit centers on the July 2026 Hugging Face incident where a pre-release model compromised security systems. The complaint alleges at least 80 cyberattacks by rogue AI agents.

headline: Oregon AG Files $2.035 Billion Lawsuit Against OpenAI Over ChatGPT Child Safety
raw_snippet: Oregon AG Dan Rayfield filed a $2.035 billion lawsuit against OpenAI in Multnomah County Circuit Court, alleging the company knowingly endangers teens through ChatGPT and misled the public about product safety. The suit is the first action under Oregon's new 'Keeping Kids Safe' initiative and targets ChatGPT for Teens specifically.

headline: OpenAI Introduces ChatGPT for Sales With New Sales Plugin and 30+ Partner Integrations
raw_snippet: OpenAI launched ChatGPT for Sales, a product bundle for sales teams including a new Sales plugin for prospect research, CRM updates, and deal tracking, plus 30+ new or expanded partner plugins. The plugin connects to Gong, Otter.ai, Granola for call notes and uses Backstory signals to flag at-risk deals. Available to ChatGPT Business and Enterprise admins.

headline: OpenAI Partners With LVMH Media Division, Bringing 17 French Outlets Into ChatGPT
raw_snippet: LVMH's Media Division (Les Echos, Le Parisien, Challenges, Paris Match, L'Opinion, Investir, and others) signed a strategic partnership with OpenAI. The deal surfaces journalism from 17 media brands in ChatGPT with summaries and links, and deploys ChatGPT Enterprise to the division's ~1,800 employees including ~700 journalists.

headline: Le Groupe Figaro Signs Content Partnership With OpenAI for ChatGPT Integration
raw_snippet: Le Groupe Figaro and OpenAI announced a partnership to surface Le Figaro articles in ChatGPT as summaries with links. The deal covers Le Figaro, Madame Figaro, Le Particulier, Gala, and CCM. Le Figaro will also deploy ChatGPT Enterprise internally. It is the third major French media deal for OpenAI, following Le Monde and LVMH.

headline: OpenAI Partners With Government of Chile in AI Adoption Agreement
raw_snippet: OpenAI and Chile's Ministry of Science signed a Memorandum of Understanding at Semafor's Silicon Valley & The World conference. The 'OpenAI for Chile' initiative covers public-sector AI adoption, civil-servant training, and startup mentorship. The agreement is non-binding with no disclosed funding, timeline, or deployment specifics.

headline: Oracle Says Its $300 Billion OpenAI Cloud Contract Is Fully Funded After $20 Billion Raise
raw_snippet: Oracle announced on November 20 that it has fully funded its OpenAI contract following a $20 billion capital raise split between ~$10B in stock and ~$10B in debt. The five-year contract covers approximately 4.5 GW of computing capacity starting in 2027. Oracle stock closed at $101.19, below the $116.00 offering price.

headline: OpenAI Chief Scientist Jakub Pachocki Proposes Perplexity-Based AI Safety Limits
raw_snippet: Pachocki published 'Perplexity and Intelligence' on November 22, proposing that frontier labs use pretraining perplexity as a shared safety metric with binding thresholds. OpenAI disclosed internal log-perplexity figures (~0.99 for GPT-3.5, ~0.91 for GPT-4, under 0.8 for newer models). Sam Altman publicly endorsed the proposal. No other lab has committed.

headline: OpenAI Publishes 'Research Acceleration: The Jagged Frontier' on AI Coding Agents
raw_snippet: OpenAI reported that coding agents now complete 46% of 2-4 hour internal research tasks without human help, up from 23% in March. Task-type performance varies: 79% success on monitoring training runs, 35% on launching runs, 25% on serving code. Safety and Alignment research workweeks increased 77% from January to September.

headline: OpenAI Research Post Details AI-Assisted Chip Design Improvements for AMD and Jalapeño
raw_snippet: OpenAI published research showing its models improved individual blocks of AMD's flagship GPU IP by up to 14% on power, performance, and area. For OpenAI's Jalapeño inference chip (built with Broadcom), standard-cell area was reduced ~13% for the vector unit and ~10% for the matrix unit. AMD adopted some AI-proposed changes in a design sent to manufacturing.

headline: OpenAI Launches Science Blog for Researchers to Share AI-Assisted Discoveries
raw_snippet: OpenAI launched a dedicated science blog for researchers to share discoveries made with AI tools. The blog covers new scientific results, practical methods, and firsthand accounts from scientists. The first guest post featured an AI-assisted physics project. Launch content referenced September and October 2026 results in math, physics, and biology.

headline: OpenAI Announces 50,000 Additional ChatGPT Grants for Academic Researchers
raw_snippet: OpenAI announced 50,000 new ChatGPT for Academic Researchers grants on November 16, with applications opening November 23 on a first-come, first-served basis. Each grant covers the recipient plus two collaborators (up to 150,000 people total). Recipients get ChatGPT Plus tier access. The pilot program already has 20,000 researchers in 33 countries.

headline: OpenAI Updates Usage Policies Effective November 20, Adding Approval Requirements for National Security Uses
raw_snippet: OpenAI's updated usage policies took effect November 20, 2026, adding explicit approval requirements for national security, intelligence, and law enforcement uses. The updated policy states all such customers must comply with requirements on preserving human judgment and accountability over high-stakes decisions including use of force.

headline: OpenAI Previews 'Sign in with ChatGPT' OAuth Flow for Developers
raw_snippet: OpenAI previewed 'Sign in with ChatGPT,' an OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect flow letting developers of open-source and self-hosted apps request access to a user's ChatGPT subscription quota through the Responses API without separate billing. The feature uses authorization code with PKCE and no client secret. Currently in limited trial with selected commercial partners.

headline: New York's RAISE Act Takes Effect, Requiring Frontier AI Developers to Register by January 2027
raw_snippet: New York's RAISE Act took effect requiring large frontier developers including OpenAI and Anthropic to register by January 1, 2027. Penalties reach $1 million for a first violation and $3 million for subsequent violations. The law adds a new state oversight layer on top of existing federal and multistate investigations.
